title: Localized consent banner states the purpose of data collection

claim.statement: The rendered consent banner text for the locale states what data is collected or why it is used.

question.instructions: The state is the visible text of a website cookie or consent notice, in any language. Which option describes the text?

criteria.A: it states why data or cookies are used (for example measurement, analytics, personalisation or advertising)
criteria.B: it does not state why data or cookies are used

notes: Measured on the pinned checkpoint, CPU fp32, eval mode, one state per forward pass: formulation `choice2_neutral` chosen on the calibration split only (highest accuracy, then lowest NLL at the fitted temperature). Held-out accuracy 0.668 (n=256); ECE (15 bins) 0.065 raw logits, 0.065 at the checkpoint's shipped temperature, 0.085 at the fitted temperature 1.344; at verify 0.85 / refute 0.85, coverage 0.008 (VERIFIED 1, REFUTED 1, INCONCLUSIVE 254) with gated precision 0.500 (Wilson 95% lower bound 0.095). Calibration split: accuracy 0.648, ECE after fitting 0.057 (n=256). Dataset: test/fixtures/system1-calibration/single-condition/consent-purpose/ (report: docs/calibration/system1-calibration-report.md, Hybrid section).

Formulations tried: noul: calibration accuracy 0.500, NLL 0.681 at T 13.14; held-out accuracy 0.500; choice2_neutral: calibration accuracy 0.648, NLL 0.644 at T 1.344; held-out accuracy 0.668; choice2_contrastive: calibration accuracy 0.547, NLL 0.648 at T 3.868; held-out accuracy 0.500; noul_sentence: calibration accuracy 0.531, NLL 0.652 at T 5.284; held-out accuracy 0.512. Controls at the fitted T: CTL-CONSENT-DE-COMPLETE VERIFIED->INCONCLUSIVE (p=0.682); CTL-CONSENT-FR-NO-PURPOSE REFUTED->INCONCLUSIVE (p=0.556); CTL-CONSENT-EN-SHOP-NOTICE REFUTED->INCONCLUSIVE (p=0.544). Replay: 5 runs per control (2 in fresh processes), max thresholded-probability delta 0, max logit delta 0; epsilon is 10x the larger of the measured delta and the delta the worst logit wobble seen on any checkpoint would cause at this temperature, rounded up.

Temperature semantics: `calibration.temperature` replaces the checkpoint's own temperature for this question's (type, option count) bucket, i.e. probabilities are softmax(option logits / T); a runner sets agent.temperature_by_options[temp_bucket] = T and passes no `lang`. `measured_ece` is the larger of the calibration-split and held-out ECE at the fitted temperature.

Held-out accuracy by variant (presence of purpose, third parties, withdrawal as 0/1): 000 0.81, 000_not_banner 0.25, 001 0.47, 010 0.56, 011 0.38, 100 0.84, 101 0.75, 110 0.84, 111 0.97. By language: de 0.56, en 0.66, es 0.81, fr 0.62, it 0.75, ja 0.66, nl 0.69, pt 0.59.

Formulations were registered in two stages: noul and choice2_neutral first; choice2_contrastive and noul_sentence after stage 1 failed on the calibration split (stage-1 held-out numbers had already been computed for two of the three disclosures). The choice among all four used the calibration split only.

Single condition: this rubric asks about one disclosure only. The consent-banner rule (purpose, third parties, withdrawal) holds for a locale when all three single-disclosure rubrics VERIFY on its banner; it replaces the multi-condition rubric RUB-S1-CONSENT-BANNER-DISCLOSURES, which scored at chance.

The held-out split is paraphrase-disjoint: calibration banners use the generator's original three paraphrases per disclosure and language, held-out banners two new ones, so held-out wording was never seen while choosing the formulation or fitting T. The paraphrases were written for this exercise; they are not reviewed native copy.
Checkpoint is pinned to laya-multilingual; Router auto-selection is not used. This checks that the disclosure is stated, not that the wording satisfies any particular law.

Not assurance-eligible: held-out gated precision 0.500 is below 0.95; Wilson 95% lower bound of held-out gated precision 0.095 (1/2) is below 0.90; controls land on the wrong status: CTL-CONSENT-DE-COMPLETE, CTL-CONSENT-FR-NO-PURPOSE, CTL-CONSENT-EN-SHOP-NOTICE; controls off their expected status in a replay run: CTL-CONSENT-DE-COMPLETE, CTL-CONSENT-FR-NO-PURPOSE, CTL-CONSENT-EN-SHOP-NOTICE. Thresholds were not lowered to compensate.
